parameters.name: accountStatus
parameters.description:
The status of the account.

Valid values:

*   DISABLE
*   ENABLE

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rocketmq list-instance-account --instance-id rmq-cn-7e22ody0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --username test --account-type CUSTOMER --account-status ENABLE --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun rocketmq GET /instances/rmq-cn-7e22ody0000/accounts --region cn-hangzhou --accountStatus ENABLE --pageNumber 1 --accountType CUSTOMER --pageSize 10 --username test --header "Content-Type=application/json"
